sections.title: Introduction to Statistics for Health Policy
sections.description: This is the first semester of a two-semester sequence. It is an introductory statistics course covering descriptive statistics, probability, random variables, estimation, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals for normally distributed and binary data. The second semester stresses regression models. Permission needed from instructor to enroll.
